title: Home services lead input
description: A niche from niches.json and an area, or a Maps dataset to score instead of searching.

area.title: Area
area.description: Region name from geo_regions.json, or City, ST. A county uses the form Monroe County, NY.

city.title: City
city.description: Optional city. Overrides the city parsed from area.

county.title: County
county.description: Optional county. Do not include the word County. Overrides the county parsed from area.

state.title: State
state.description: Optional two-letter state. Overrides the state parsed from area.

mapsDataset.title: Maps dataset
mapsDataset.description: Upstream Maps rows. When set, the Actor scores these listings and does not open Google Maps.

maxItems.title: Max accepted leads
maxItems.description: Stop after this many accepted matches. Default 10, maximum 25.

maxSearches.title: Max Maps searches
maxSearches.description: Keyword and place searches when mapsDataset is omitted. Default 5, maximum 20.

maxResults.title: Max results per search
maxResults.description: Listings opened per Maps search. Default 5, maximum 10.

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.description: Issue #127 score required for an accepted place. Default 80.

lowConfidenceFloor.title: Low-confidence floor
lowConfidenceFloor.description: Scores at or above this floor and below the minimum are rejected and not billed. Default 60.

includeEmail.title: Find website email
includeEmail.description: Read emails from the business website after robots.txt allows it. Billed only when a validated address is found.

includeWebsiteQuality.title: Score website quality
includeWebsiteQuality.description: Fetch the business website after robots.txt allows it and record website_quality. Higher means a weaker site.

includeScore.title: Score the lead
includeScore.description: Write lead_score and intent signals. Billed only when a score is produced.
